quimicaPasion.Alta: The physical chemistry and passion between you are intense. There is a magnetism felt in the body, an attraction that needs no words. Sensory intimacy is a ground where you flow naturally.
quimicaPasion.Media: There is a sensual chemistry that, while present, is not overwhelming. There is attraction and desire, but it needs to be consciously cultivated and expressed to last over time.
quimicaPasion.Baja: Physical chemistry is subtle. Passion is not the main engine of the relationship, but it can be activated with conscious gestures of connection and affection.
quimicaPasion.MuyBaja: Sensual chemistry is faint. The connection is not based on passion, but on other planes. It is important to recognize this without judgment and nurture intimacy through other channels.

afinidadMental.Alta: Mental affinity is extraordinary. You share a language, a way of processing the world. Dialogues are fluid, stimulating and enriching. Conversing is a shared pleasure.
afinidadMental.Media: Communication flows naturally, though there are nuances to polish. You grasp the essentials, but details sometimes need clarification. Mental affinity is a good foundation to grow.
afinidadMental.Baja: Mental affinity has nuances. It is not that you do not understand each other, but that you process information differently. Patience and active listening are key to dialogue.
afinidadMental.MuyBaja: Communication styles are very different. What is clear to one is confusing to the other. It requires conscious effort of translation and mental empathy.

conexionEmocional.Alta: The emotional connection is deep. You feel seen, held and understood in the most intimate way. There is a language of silences and gestures that needs no words. It is a shared emotional home.
conexionEmocional.Media: The emotional connection is good, with moments of great resonance and others of misunderstanding. You love each other, but sometimes speak different emotional languages. Recognizing that strengthens the bond.
conexionEmocional.Baja: The emotional connection requires work. It is not a lack of love, but of resonance. Each processes emotions differently, which can create moments of shared loneliness.
conexionEmocional.MuyBaja: The emotional worlds are very different. What is a need for one is excess for the other. It requires much compassion and a willingness to understand the other without imposing your own language.

sintoniaEspiritual.Alta: Spiritual resonance is notable. There is a sense of shared destiny, as if the souls recognized each other. You share deep values and a transcendent vision of life.
sintoniaEspiritual.Media: Spiritual resonance is subtle but present. There are moments when you feel something greater than yourselves, but it is not something that fills the whole relationship. It is cultivated with shared practices.
sintoniaEspiritual.Baja: Spiritual resonance is faint. It is not that it does not exist, but that it expresses through different channels. Each connects with the transcendent in their own way, and that is valid.
sintoniaEspiritual.MuyBaja: Spiritual visions are very different. It is not a lack of depth, but of code. It requires respecting the other's path without imposing your own.

estabilidadFuturo.Alta: The stability of the bond is notable. There is a commitment that holds with solidity, a sense of "this lasts". Saturn and the foundations of the relationship are firm.
estabilidadFuturo.Media: Stability is good, with moments of solidity and others of adjustment. The relationship has foundations, but requires conscious maintenance to last over time.
estabilidadFuturo.Baja: Stability requires work. It is not that the relationship is fragile, but that commitments can feel restrictive to one and necessary to the other. It requires dialogue about expectations.
estabilidadFuturo.MuyBaja: Stability is a challenge. The structure of the bond can feel rigid to one and unstable to the other. It requires much awareness and voluntary commitment to build foundations.

compat.85: This relationship has an exceptional resonance ({score}%). {label}. It is a bond that feels like a shared destiny, where energies amplify each other in most dimensions.
compat.70: This relationship has a solid affinity ({score}%). {label}. There are firm foundations and a connection that, with awareness, can be sustained and grow over time.
compat.55: This relationship has an attraction with nuances ({score}%). {label}. There is chemistry and connection, but also areas that will ask for work. It is a bond that teaches as much as it unites.
compat.40: This relationship is a formative challenge ({score}%). {label}. It is not an easy connection, but it is a school. What is built here is built with effort and depth.
compat.0: This relationship follows diverging paths ({score}%). {label}. It is not a lack of value, but of natural resonance. What is shared is shared from difference.

sinastria.desgloseNota: The global % is the weighted sum of 8 factors (weight × score).
sinastria.cartaCompuestaDesc: The composite chart is the midpoint of each planet pair: the "relationship" as its own entity.
sinastria.casa7Desc: The Descendant (ASC + 180°) marks commitment. Planets of one person near the other's Descendant activate the partnership.
sinastria.factorDesc_quimica: Physical attraction and passion between you.
sinastria.factorDesc_emocional: Connection of feelings and mutual care.
sinastria.factorDesc_espiritual: Deep values and sense of destiny.
sinastria.factorDesc_elementos: Harmony between the elements of your charts.
sinastria.factorDesc_casa7: Planets near the commitment axis (7th House).
sinastria.factorDesc_compuesta: The relationship as its own entity (composite chart).
sinastria.consejo_quimica: Feed the spark: leave room for desire, surprise and play between you.
sinastria.consejo_emocional: Practice listening and emotional safety: say what you feel and validate the other.
sinastria.consejo_mental: Improve communication: talk calmly and listen actively before arguing.
sinastria.consejo_espiritual: Share a practice or values: connect on what gives meaning to your life.
sinastria.consejo_estabilidad: Strengthen the foundation: set clear expectations, routines and long-term agreements.
sinastria.consejo_elementos: Appreciate temperament differences: balance fire, earth, air and water.
sinastria.consejo_casa7: Tend to commitment and the partnership axis: make time to build your "us".
sinastria.consejo_compuesta: Know each other as a unit: define a shared project or vision for the relationship.
sinastria.netoDisclaimer: General balance of all aspects. The factor breakdown shows the day-to-day of the relationship better.

onboarding.paso1_texto: Discover the exact position of the planets at your birth with surgical precision. Explore your houses, aspects, and the elemental balance of your natal chart.
onboarding.paso2_texto: Perform 1-card, 3-card, or full Celtic Cross readings. Each card is interpreted with its deep meaning and its relationship to your question.
onboarding.paso3_texto: The ancient Chinese oracle accompanies every Tarot reading. Toss the virtual coins, get your hexagram, and discover the mutant lines that mark your future.
onboarding.paso4_texto: Generate deep, personalized analyses of your readings and birth chart with oracular artificial intelligence. Your guide to self-knowledge.
onboarding.paso5_texto: Tap any underlined technical term (cards, planets, signs, houses, aspects) to see a short, clear description. An easy way to learn while you explore your oracle.
onboarding.paso6_texto: Compare two saved birth charts and discover the couple's compatibility: passion, mind, emotion, spirit and stability, with a radar chart and AI analysis.
